prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your organization type, goals, budget and required services. I can, however, help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me build a tailored shortlist:

- Are you a hospital system, health clinic, physician practice, med device company, pharma, or health-tech startup?
- Do you need brand strategy, digital/SEO, paid media, content, patient acquisition, physician recruitment, PR, or something else?
- Do you want a local St. Louis agency only, or are national firms acceptable?
- Rough budget range and timeline?
- Any must-have experience (e.g., HIPAA/FDA-regulated work, enterprise EMR/CRM integrations, B2B vs B2C)?

If you’d like me to proceed, I can:
- Curate a shortlist (3–5) of top St. Louis healthcare marketing agencies with strengths, case-study highlights, and suggested interview questions; or
- Draft an RFP or scoring rubric you can use to evaluate proposals; or
- Give a set of interview questions and KPIs to use when vetting agencies.

How would you like to proceed?

Useful criteria to evaluate agencies right away:
- Proven healthcare experience and relevant case studies
- Understanding of regulatory constraints (HIPAA, FDA, etc.)
- Measurable outcomes (CPL, LTV, conversion lifts, ROI)
- Digital capabilities: SEO, paid search/social, analytics, CRM integration
- Content/creative strengths for patient education or clinician audiences
- Local market knowledge and referral-network experience
- Client references in similar-size organizations
- Clear reporting cadence and transparent pricing

Sample interview questions (I can expand):
- Tell us about a recent campaign for a similar healthcare client. What were the goals and results?
- How do you handle patient privacy and regulatory compliance in marketing?
- Which KPIs do you recommend and how frequently do you report them?
- Who will be on our account team and what are their backgrounds?
- What tools do you use for analytics, CRM, and marketing automation?

Tell me the answers to the initial questions above (or say “just find St. Louis agencies”) and I’ll build a specific shortlist.
